markers.source_table: Massoni-Badosa et al. 2024 epithelial compartment; KRTDAP function per Su et al. 2021

other_findings.finding: The epithelial compartment comprised three clusters overlapping keratinocyte populations of the oral mucosa; one expressed FDCSP and was annotated 'FDCSP epithelium'.
FDCSP was first described in FDC and in leukocyte-infiltrated tonsillar crypts; the atlas provides evidence that FDCSP-expressing cells are a specific subpopulation of the tonsillar epithelium.

note: No PMC supplement retrieved for this run; findings drawn from atlas main-text snippets via ASTA snippet_search (paper_ids=CorpusId:250093999). All marker expression is transcript-level (scRNA-seq), not protein.
